caption: The video captures a wide, locked-off view of a glacier-fed alpine lake beneath a snow-covered glacier and rocky peaks. A steep forested cliff and pine slope rise on the left, while a tree-covered mountain slope closes the right side of the valley. In the left foreground, a pale rocky shoreline with scattered boulders meets clear shallow water. The lower-center lake carries a bright white reflection of sky and glacier, and this reflection continuously deforms into shifting horizontal shimmer bands as small ripples pass across the surface. On the right, the transparent water over rounded submerged stones shows subtle ongoing distortion, while a few small red canoes remain at nearly the same positions along the distant horizon. The mountains, forest, shoreline, and framing stay fixed throughout.
